isaac.rigid: Original OBJ coordinates, fan triangulation; dynamic meshes explicitly use native convexHull, static/driven meshes triangle collision. Balls native analytical sphere; pendula native revolute joints. Native cooking may differ from author runner.
isaac.soft: Open original task USD; session layer overrides calibrated metadata material, pose, and attachment recipes, then native PhysX cooking. Includes static support represented as fixed-pose kinematic rigid. SurfaceFEM thickness and bend mapping follow paper Appendix A.2.2.
isaac.controls: Native rigid-body kinematic targets; fixed initial pose for supports. No PD, no XiePhysic-specific gap.
isaac.non_calibrated_settings: Rigid reconstruction uses SDK defaults. Soft reconstruction retains authored official USD collision/solver fields, except documented backend/timing and calibrated-material overrides. Example textile simulation_mesh contactOffset=0.01m, restOffset=0 inherited from original asset; this is asset-authored, not a newly tuned value. See usd_authored_solver_settings.json.

newton.rigid: Original OBJ vertices and fan triangles to Newton Mesh; SolverMuJoCo native mesh conversion/cooking. Balls analytical sphere and native revolute joint.
newton.cloth: Original OBJ-derived world-space vertices and triangles; SolverVBD constructor defaults. Calibrated material stiffness uses paper Appendix A.2.2 equations 10-12, including Ks/2.7 fallback. Particle radius argument omitted: Newton 1.3.0 native default 0.1m; default GPU tile solve enabled. All18cloth rerun in results/newton_strict_defaults.
newton.volume: Official USD simulation tet vertices, exact-coordinate weld and duplicate-cell removal; lumped tet volume sets particle mass/radius for native SolverImplicitMPM. Native default voxel_size=0.1m, no resolution tuning. Native particles are not a FEM tet discretization.
newton.controls: Native kinematic bodies and zero-mass Dirichlet boundary vertices/particles; prescribed boundary end positions projected only for those particles. Free particles untouched; pre-projection drift recorded. No PD.

shared_processing.units: Raw measured positions mm to engine m (x0.001); scoring position inputs converted back to mm; USD metersPerUnit inspected, no arbitrary spatial scaling.
shared_processing.orientation: Metadata Euler degrees to quaternions; quaternion component ordering adapted to native APIs. No estimated coordinate axis rotation.
shared_processing.drivers: Arithmetic translation mean and rotational mean across supplied repeats; relative to mean initial state, registered to metadata scene anchor. Continuous interpolation at simulation dt. Unverified author trial selection/averaging.
shared_processing.references: Original reference files immutable; primary audit uses all supplied trials and literal inclusive-mean formulas. Eight released cohorts contain 19..25 trials although paper §4.1 states 20; author inclusion list unconfirmed. No silent dropping or fabricated missing data. Marker identities/topology unconfirmed.
shared_processing.gap: No XiePhysic 2mm cradle gap applied to these third-party runs.
shared_processing.material: Measured metadata used and paper per-model physical conversions. Original USD template material numbers overridden in session; full snapshot retained.
shared_processing.initial_velocity: Dynamic bodies use the zero initial velocities in frozen scene recipes; no velocity was fitted to simulator scores.

native_rigid_initial_frame_checks: native_rigid_initial_frame_audit.json: all 27 generic rigid initial origins equal real initial mean within floating precision

superseded_cloth_policy: Previous explicit thickness/2 radius was our interpretation, not specified in paper; previous trajectories and reports retained as history, excluded from current cloth comparison.
recorded_simulation_logic_preserved: See adapter_cleanup_audit.json: unchanged simulation AST, formatted public code and early runtime identity guards.
